from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///notes.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False
    
    db.init_app(app)
    
    # Import models before creating the database
    from app.models.note import Note
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()
    
    # Register routes
    from app.routes import main_bp
    app.register_blueprint(main_bp)
    
    return app

from app import create_app

app = create_app()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True)

code_repository.readme_content:
# Simple Note-Taking App

An application for entering and saving text on a single page.

## Features

- Text Entry: Allows users to input text on a single page.
- Save Notes: Enables users to save the entered text for future reference.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
